symbols.note: from gatekit symbols system --dll dx11 --full; '-' addresses (null) mean the method was not found in bg3_dx11.exe; the component lists come from the method parameter types, not from the code.
symbols.limits: reads/writes: the component views in the parameters of the system's exported methods. uses: the component operations (add, remove, get, has) its per-frame update performs through the engine's out-of-line helpers, itself or in a function it calls (depth 2), with the call site; kind index: a matched method reads the type's index and the operation is not known. Not listed: operations the compiler inlined, those deeper than depth 2, and what a method that is not the update does (e.g. a SystemLoad) - read its pseudo-code; an empty writes list is not "writes nothing".

does.text: Called from story code with an entity and a yes/no to block or allow dismissing that character from the party. It stores the request in the system's own list; the component is changed in the next Update.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll named pseudo-code, LEGACY_SetBlockDismiss (190 lines): signature (entity, bool) and a list insertion; the allocation message only.

does.text: Applies the stored requests. For an allow (unblock) request on an entity that has BlockDismissComponent it removes it and adds BlockDismissRemovedOneFrameComponent to the same entity. For a block request on an entity without BlockDismissComponent it adds it. Other combinations do nothing.
does.evidence: Review (Opus, 14 Nov): EoCServer.dll+0xAC7880: a bit test of DAT_18223736c (BlockDismissComponent) on the entity and the request flag guard RemoveComponentUnchecked(BlockDismiss) plus helper +0xAC5FD0 (AllocRaw of DAT_182237370 = BlockDismissRemovedOneFrameComponent), and helper +0xAC5DE0 (AllocRaw of BlockDismissComponent).

does.text: Removes the BlockDismissRemoved one-frame component from entities each frame.
does.evidence: Review (Opus, 14 Nov): EoCServer.dll+0xAC6F30: RemoveComponentUnchecked of DAT_182237370 = BlockDismissRemovedOneFrameComponent in a loop.
